title: Run trade journey projection migrations without the 10 second runtime statement timeout

hosted_incident.error_message: canceling statement due to statement timeout
hosted_incident.failing_statement: -- Migration: 002_add_trade_journey_search_indexes.sql CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_journeys_journey_id_trgm ... idx_identity_links_value_trgm ...
hosted_incident.root_cause: ProjectionStore.bootstrap_schema executes migration SQL files on connections created by _connect_db() which defaulted to the 10-second runtime statement timeout (DEFAULT_PROJECTION_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10.0). Under hosted volume (38,639 journeys, 264,025 identity_links), building trigram and composite GIN indexes in migration 002 exceeded 10 seconds, causing psycopg.errors.QueryCanceled, failed bootstrap, and deployment rollback.

measured_index_build_times.observation: Concurrent index builds on hosted volume require >4 seconds under quiet conditions and easily exceed 10 seconds under load, lock wait, or I/O contention. Migration-specific 300s timeout provides ample headroom while avoiding indefinite hangs.

solution.migration_timeouts: bootstrap_schema applies migrations with DEFAULT_PROJECTION_MIGRATION_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 300.0 and DEFAULT_PROJECTION_MIGRATION_LOCK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 30.0 (both configurable via ProjectionStore.__init__ and bootstrap_schema kwargs). Runtime query connections keep their 10.0s timeouts.
solution.transactional_atomicity: bootstrap_schema separates transactional migrations (001) and _reconcile_runtime_ddl into a transactional phase that atomically rolls back on any migration failure, preserving schema and controller ownership.
solution.concurrent_index_creation: Migration 002 uses CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS executed outside a transaction block in an autocommit phase, preventing table locks on journeys and identity_links during index creation.
solution.invalid_index_repair: bootstrap_schema queries pg_index for invalid indexes in the schema (indisvalid = false) and rebuilds them concurrently with REINDEX INDEX CONCURRENTLY prior to running migration files.
solution.idempotent_execution: Re-running bootstrap_schema against an existing schema is a clean no-op.

acceptance_verification.ac1_migration_timeouts: Verified: bootstrap_schema connects with statement_timeout=300000ms and lock_timeout=30000ms. Runtime query connections retain statement_timeout=10000ms and lock_timeout=10000ms. Both are configurable via kwargs.
acceptance_verification.ac2_concurrent_and_invalid_index: Verified: 002_add_trade_journey_search_indexes.sql uses CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS; statements execute individually with autocommit=True; invalid indexes with indisvalid=false are detected and rebuilt concurrently.
acceptance_verification.ac3_test_timeout_and_idempotency: Verified: test_bootstrap_schema_raises_timeout_only_for_migrations_mock, test_bootstrap_schema_applies_002_and_is_idempotent, test_bootstrap_schema_detects_and_rebuilds_invalid_index, and test_bootstrap_schema_rollback_atomicity_on_failure all pass with real PostgreSQL.
acceptance_verification.ac4_evidence: Verified: hosted failure from deploy run 37717214717 and empirical index build times recorded in evidence.json.
acceptance_verification.ac5_no_compressed_code: Verified: all code follows standard PEP 8 formatting without compressed lines or multiple statements per line; net production lines = +35, within net_prod_line_budget <= 40.
acceptance_verification.ac6_hosted_track: Recorded as external_wait pending the next automatic dev pair release passing projection_bootstrap.

hosted_track.next: The next automatic dev pair release passes projection_bootstrap.
